caption: Welcome to HalalBook
say: Welcome to HalalBook. A beautiful, safe social home for friends and family, open to everyone.

caption: Join in a minute
say: Joining takes a minute. Choose whether you'd like Islamic features like prayer times and the dua wall, or keep it general. You can change this any time.

caption: Your home feed
say: Your home feed starts with your day: the verse of the day in your own language, Jummah reminders on Fridays, and friends' birthdays.

caption: Post, poll or schedule
say: Share a post, a photo or a video. Add a poll, ask your friends for dua, or tap the clock to schedule it for later. Type the at sign to mention a friend.

caption: Live poll results
say: Friends vote in your poll with one tap, and see the results straight away.

caption: Reels and short videos
say: Short videos are grouped by subject. Tap one and they play one after another, like on Facebook and TikTok.

caption: Messages in your language
say: In Messages, every chat is translated into your language automatically. React to a message, reply to it, send a voice note, or mark it urgent.

caption: Marketplace
say: The Marketplace lets you buy and sell with people nearby. Halal items only. Message the seller with one tap.

caption: Quran khatm together
say: Start a Quran khatm with your family. Everyone takes a juz, and HalalBook tells you when all thirty are finished.

caption: Zakat calculator
say: The Zakat calculator uses today's gold and silver prices in your own currency.

caption: Tasbeeh
say: And the tasbeeh counts your dhikr with a gentle buzz, after every salah.

caption: You're in control
say: In Settings, you're in control. Choose a calm feed with fewer heated posts, set Do Not Disturb with your family always getting through, and pick your language.

caption: 19 languages
say: HalalBook speaks nineteen languages, including Arabic, Urdu and Bangla, and turns right to left for Arabic.

caption: halalbook.app
say: HalalBook. Your community is waiting. Join free at halal book dot app.
